lines.text: 三类材料：导电差异不只看带隙数字
lines.zh: 三类材料：导电差异不只看带隙数字
lines.en: Three material classes: conduction differs for more than just the gap value

lines.text: 能带占据 / 带重叠 / 热激发 /电阻率
lines.zh: 能带占据 / 带重叠 / 热激发 /电阻率
lines.en: Band occupation / band overlap / thermal excitation / resistivity

lines.text: 材料电导由能带结构、费米能级附近的允许态、载流子浓度和迁移率共同决定。
lines.zh: 材料电导由能带结构、费米能级附近的允许态、载流子浓度和迁移率共同决定。
lines.en: Conductivity is jointly determined by band structure, allowed states near the Fermi level, carrier concentration and mobility.

lines.text: 费米能级附近有允许态，易导电
lines.zh: 费米能级附近有允许态，易导电
lines.en: Allowed states near the Fermi level enable easy conduction

lines.text: 有适中带隙，戴流子可受控产生
lines.zh: 有适中带隙，载流子可受控产生
lines.en: A moderate gap allows controlled carrier generation

lines.text: 带隙很大，常温下几乎无自由载流子
lines.zh: 带隙很大，常温下几乎无自由载流子
lines.en: A large gap gives almost no free carriers at room temperature

lines.uncertain: 原图以≈0描述金属带隙，为教学简化；数值分类不是严格通用边界。

lines.text: 温度升高，电阻通常增加
lines.zh: 温度升高，电阻通常增加

lines.en: Low density of states near E_F

lines.text: E： 附近几乎没有允许态
lines.en: Almost no allowed states near E_F
Moderate (determined by intrinsic behavior or doping)

lines.text: 常温下仍很难激发载流子
lines.zh: 常温下仍很难激发载流子
lines.en: Carriers remain difficult to excite at room temperature

lines.text: 电导很小，高溫下可能略增
lines.zh: 电导很小，高温下可能略增
lines.en: Very low conductivity; may increase slightly at high temperature

lines.zh: • 本征载流子更少，耐高温、漏电更低
lines.en: • Fewer intrinsic carriers, higher temperature tolerance and lower leakage

lines.zh: • 但载流子注入更难、掺杂更难、低电阻接触更挑战。
lines.en: • But carrier injection, doping and low-resistance contacts are more difficult.

lines.zh: • 更容易导电，适合高速和低电压应用
lines.en: • Easier conduction, suitable for high-speed and low-voltage applications

lines.zh: • 但高温漏电增加，热稳定性变差
lines.en: • But high-temperature leakage rises and thermal stability worsens

lines.zh: 只看一个E_g数值就分类材料
lines.en: Classifying materials from a single E_g value

lines.zh: 绝缘体绝对不导电（实际仍有缺陷导电、表面导电等）
lines.en: Insulators never conduct (defect conduction, surface conduction, etc. still occur)

lines.zh: 忽略温度、缺陷、杂质、强电场等对电导的影响
lines.en: Ignoring effects of temperature, defects, impurities and high electric fields on conduction
• Estimate gap E_g from the absorption edge

lines.zh: • 评估高场下的导电与耐压
lines.en: • Evaluate high-field conduction and voltage withstand capability

lines.zh: 可控载流子与高迁移率
宽带隙、耐高压、发光 / 探测
lines.en: Wide gap, high voltage tolerance, light emission / detection

lines.zh: 分类不仅取决于带隙大小，还与能带形状、缺陷、相、杂质、样品质量和测试条件有关。
lines.en: Classification depends on gap size, band shape, defects, phase, impurities, sample quality and test conditions.
